title: Chemical Specifications, Dosing Calculation Rules, Compatibility & Operating Conditions

data.Purpose: Colloidal charge neutralization and primary dye/TSS precipitation.
data.Dosage Calculation Method: Jar Test optimization: Dose (mg/L) = (Jar Opt Vol (mL) * Stock Conc (mg/mL)) / Sample Vol (L)
data.Incompatible Chemicals: Lime/Caustic (when dosed simultaneously prior to flash mixing)
data.Addition Sequence: 1st Acid pre-neutralization -> 2nd Alum dosing -> 3rd Polymer dosing
data.Mixing Conditions: High-shear Rapid Flash Mix (G > 300 s⁻¹, 200 RPM)

data.Purpose: Rapid floc formation, effective color reduction with lower sludge volume.
data.Dosage Calculation Method: Dose = Feed Flow (m³/hr) * Target ppm / Active Purity %
data.Addition Sequence: Dose into Flash Mixer immediately after raw water pH adjustment

data.Purpose: Decolorization of sulfur/reactive dyes and catalyst for hydrogen peroxide radical oxidation.
data.Dosage Calculation Method: Molar ratio Fe²⁺ : H₂O₂ = 1:3 to 1:5 in Fenton reactor
data.Incompatible Chemicals: Oxidizers (prior to Fenton stage), High pH (> 4.0 during Fenton reaction)
data.Addition Sequence: Fenton: 1st Acid to pH 3.2 -> 2nd FeSO4 -> 3rd H2O2 -> 4th Lime to pH 8.0
data.Mixing Conditions: Continuous moderate agitation in acid-resistant reactor

data.Purpose: Bridging micro-flocs into dense settleable macro-flocs in tube settlers.
data.Dosage Calculation Method: 0.1% Stock Solution preparation with 45 min aging time
data.Incompatible Chemicals: High concentration Oxidants, Cationic Polymers (cause mutual precipitation)
data.Addition Sequence: Dose at entrance to Flocculator paddle chamber AFTER coagulant flash mixing

data.Purpose: Generate free hydroxyl radicals (•OH) for refractory dye ring destruction.
data.Dosage Calculation Method: Based on residual hard COD: 1.5 - 2.5 g H2O2 per gram COD to be removed
data.Incompatible Chemicals: Reducing Agents (SMBS), Alkaline Solutions, Organic Contaminants in storage
data.Addition Sequence: Dose strictly AFTER FeSO4 addition under acidic conditions pH 3.2
data.Mixing Conditions: Continuous uniform agitation in vented reactor tank

data.Purpose: Neutralize residual free chlorine to protect polyamide RO membranes from oxidation.
data.Dosage Range: 2.0 - 5.0 mg/L (1.47 mg SMBS per 1.0 mg Free Chlorine)
data.Dosage Calculation Method: Continuous ORP feedback dosing: Target ORP < 200 mV
data.Incompatible Chemicals: Hydrogen Peroxide, Ozone, Chlorine Gas, Sodium Hypochlorite
data.Addition Sequence: Dose in-line into UF Permeate pipe stream prior to RO High Pressure Pump

data.Purpose: Prevent precipitation of CaSO4, CaCO3, BaSO4, and Silica on RO membranes.
data.Dosage Calculation Method: Projection software calculation based on RO feed brine ion solubility product
data.Incompatible Chemicals: Cationic Coagulants / Polymers (causes irreversible membrane fouling)
data.Addition Sequence: Dose continuously into RO feed line interlocked with RO High Pressure Pump
